what: the original CALPUFF 7.2.1 puff-step advection state for the frozen Hefei 2022 case, exported by write-only instrumentation of the unmodified vendor source
why: P7U pinned the advection chain and asked for the observable variables at named lines; none of them appears in puff.con

item6_sampling_cadence.when: the sampling-step cadence of this puff (nsam, nsstr, xsami, tsamp, reftsamp, iold, istype, ipno, wsvar)

item1_start_of_step.when: the start-of-step puff state (the comparison's initial condition)

item2_cell_parameters.when: the met cell and parameters the step uses

item3_puffdz_return.when: the averaging layer bounds from PUFFDZ

item4_advect_return.when: the advective wind from ADVECT (METFM=1 -> ADVWND)

item5_after_adjustments.when: the effective transport speed after RISEWIND and the calm treatment

item8a_setpuf_entry.when: SETPUF entry: the stored puff state and the /CURRENT/ values carried over from the previous puff

item7_setpuf_return.when: SETPUF return and the end-of-step puff position; this call writes the record

source.write_only: both the untouched original and the instrumented copy were compiled and run on identical inputs; puff.con must hash identically (dgm-audit.json)

binary.order: records are ordered by timestep, then puff index, then sampling substep; each record carries its own key (packed, ii, ksam)

packed.meaning: current timestep beginning time, packed YYYYJJJHH (/DATEHR/ ndathrb)

ixs.meaning: met cell i at the start of the step

iys.meaning: met cell j at the start of the step

mdoms.meaning: met domain of the start cell

istab.meaning: PG stability class at the start cell

nsam.meaning: number of sampling substeps for this puff

iold.meaning: 1 = old puff, 0 = new puff, 2 = road slug

mdstep.meaning: met domain used for the step size

lcalm.meaning: 1 when the calm treatment was applied, else 0

lpuff.meaning: 1 for a Gaussian puff, 0 for a slug

islug.meaning: 1 for a slug, 0 for a puff

xold.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

yold.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

zold.meaning: start-of-step puff height above sea level

dpbl.meaning: mixing height at the start cell (clamped)

el.meaning: Monin-Obukhov length at the start cell

z0m.meaning: roughness length at the start cell

ztop.meaning: top of the averaging layer (PUFFDZ return)

zbot.meaning: bottom of the averaging layer (PUFFDZ return)

ws.meaning: speed after the rise-wind and calm adjustments

xsami.meaning: reciprocal of the number of sampling steps (set for old puffs; carried over for new puffs)

tsamp.meaning: sampling step length at the cadence point (before any subsampling split)

wsvar.meaning: wind speed used for variable sampling (new puffs)

xtotb_in.meaning: total travel distance of the puff before SETPUF

tmtotb_in.meaning: total travel time of the puff before SETPUF

sigzb_in.meaning: stored sigma-z before SETPUF (after any vertical divergence adjustment of this substep)

xpb_in.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

ypb_in.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

xb1_in.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)
xb1_in.meaning: /CURRENT/ xb1 entering SETPUF (carried over from the previous puff)

yb1_in.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

xe1_in.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

ye1_in.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

xnew.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)
xnew.meaning: end-of-step puff x before SETPUF stores it

ynew.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

sigyb_out.meaning: stored sigma-y after SETPUF (start of next step)

sigzb_out.meaning: stored sigma-z after SETPUF (start of next step)

xpb_out.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

ypb_out.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

zpb_out.meaning: stored puff z after SETPUF (CALPUFF has no `znew`; the vertical end position is the internal `ze1`, and this is the stored result)

xb1_out.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

yb1_out.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

xe1_out.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

ye1_out.units: grid units (cells of the outermost met grid; 1 cell = 100 m here)

ze1_out.meaning: /CURRENT/ ze1 after SETPUF (the vertical end position)

tleft.meaning: time left in the sampling step

tsampsum.meaning: sampling time accumulated before this substep

tsamp_effective.meaning: sampling substep length actually used by this step (the `tsamp` variable at the SETPUF call)

missing_sentinel.note: no value is missing at these points; CALPUFF's own missing markers are not used in these arrays, so a reader must not special-case any value

time.label: packed YYYYJJJHH beginning time of the met timestep (/DATEHR/ ndathrb) plus its seconds (/DATEHR/ nsecb)

slice.note: byte-identical records copied out of the full dump
